marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to southeast 20 knots near noon then
veering to southwest 15 late overnight. Wind veering to west 20 Sunday
afternoon. Periods of snow this afternoon tonight and Sunday.
Visibility as low as 1 mile in snow. Temperatures near zero. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2
Sunday evening.<br/>

marine.title: Extended Forecast
marine.text:
Monday: Wind west 25 knots diminishing to northwest 15
 late in the day.<br/>Tuesday: Wind northwest 15 knots diminishing to
 light.<br/>Wednesday: Wind light becoming southeast 15 knots late
 in the day.<br/>
